requirements.description: User wants the property near green spaces. Per the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74, the property should be in the top quartile for green-space proximity.
User prefers energy class C or better, so energy_class is restricted to A1-A4, B and C. energy_score_class cannot be used because C shares the score value 3 with B-E.

The user explicitly requires at least 95 sqm of gross floor area. The four-person capacity and the home-based nursery use are not gross-area requirements and were not converted into a surface filter. Energy class and proximity to green spaces are not reference columns and were ignored. The residential typology was not returned because the list of available typologies provided is empty.

output.explanation: Filters on surface_area >= 95, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, green >= 74, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by distance from that point. No predicates were added beyond the extracted requirements.
